chapter.verse: Topa a muang mite pen, ling loin a om tawntung Zion Mual tawh kibang hi.
Mualte in Jerusalem kimkotah a om mah bangin, Topa in ama mite’ kimkotah tu-a kipanin a tawntungin om ding hi.
Thuman mite in khialhna a bawl khak loh nadingun, amaute tunga kipia leitang tungah migilote in amaute uk paisuak lo ding hi.
Topa aw, a hoih mite tung leh na thupiakna a zui mite tungah hehpihna hong nei in!
Ahih hangin amau’ gitlohna a zui mite pen siatna bawlte daan na piak ciangin, amaute tawh pia khawm in. Israelte tungah nopna om ta hen!
